method: Three fresh reviewers a round, each given only the seven blind sheets (docs/hobie16-8/blind/<sheet>.jpg) and the cards' level descriptions, described each panel A to E first (so the letters are tied to what they saw), then put each sheet's letters in level order (each level once) and named the least convincing thing on each sheet. Rule (wear_check_hobie16.py): a reviewer passes a sheet with all five right or one swap of neighbouring levels; a sheet passes when at least three reviewers do. Each round's reviewers are new; the rounds' renders differ (the fixes between them are in docs/hobie16-8). From round 2 they also compared the round's renders with round 1's at six years half kept and twenty years neglected (A or B, left and right shuffled per sheet; from round 4 shuffled per reviewer too, since rounds 2 and 3 showed a pull toward B): 'ab' holds each round's keys, winners and tallies.
